brief:
Gaza faces severe flooding as the territory grapples with a humanitarian crisis, Shehab Wire reported. The situation has claimed lives, including those of children and women, according to the report.

The flooding compounds existing hardships in Gaza, where residents face shortages of shelter and other essential aid. The report suggests that leadership has failed to secure peace or provide adequate humanitarian assistance to address the escalating needs.

title: Gaza struggles amid flooding as aid remains scarce
